name: AI 数据中台
positioning: 适合模型任务、数据资产、质量监测和团队协作类网页 Demo

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.font_family: system sans-serif with Chinese platform fonts
design_tokens.shadow_style: mostly border-defined surfaces with very restrained neutral shadows

layout_rules: Use a light narrow sidebar, white top bar, thin neutral dividers, and a cool near-white canvas.
Show exactly one of five top-level pages and keep inactive pages hidden from layout and scrolling.
Use crisp information hierarchy, restrained 8 to 12 pixel radii, generous whitespace, and minimal shadows.
Present overview metrics as monochrome cards with small colored icon containers rather than gradient KPI blocks.
Use line and bar charts built with inline SVG and CSS, with explicit labels and supporting values.
Inspect model tasks in a centered detail dialog and confirm completion in a second focused dialog.
Support a real light and dark web theme without adding Tailwind or any runtime dependency.
Use an off-canvas web sidebar below 900px and never imply a native desktop application.

component_inventory.name: light_navigation
component_inventory.use_for: five mutually exclusive AI data pages

component_inventory.name: chart_panel
component_inventory.use_for: period-dependent task throughput and data quality

component_inventory.name: center_dialog
component_inventory.use_for: task inspection, confirmation, task creation, and invitations

component_inventory.name: asset_view
component_inventory.use_for: real grid and list presentation switching

interaction_contracts: Every visible enabled control produces navigation, filtering, download, state change, form validation, theme change, or visible data feedback.
Top-level navigation synchronizes visible page, aria-current, breadcrumb, document title, URL hash, scroll position, and narrow sidebar state.
Period switching recalculates model metrics and chart series from current mock tasks.
Task filtering exposes result count and empty state; reset restores the complete task list.
CSV export creates a nonempty file from current filtered tasks.
Task completion requires confirmation and updates task table, overview metrics, asset summaries, team load, and notifications.
Task creation and member invitation validate required input before mutating shared in-memory state.
Dialogs support cancel, explicit close, Escape, focus containment, and focus restoration.
Theme, notification, and default-period settings can be saved and restored.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion and retain keyboard-operable focus states.

preserve: light narrow sidebar and white top bar
crisp neutral borders and restrained blue primary
monochrome metric cards with colored icon tiles
minimal shadows and clear data tables
replace_from_development_document: AI task and data asset entities
metrics, chart series, filters, table fields, statuses, and transitions
members, roles, notifications, settings, and all mock records
dialog contents, validation rules, and feedback copy
avoid: TailAdmin logos, brand names, screenshots, icons, illustrations, product copy, fonts, or upstream source code
TailAdmin PRO or commercial components and assets
Tailwind, React, CDN, online fonts, APIs, analytics, or any build/runtime dependency
fake controls, fake exports, or success feedback without data mutation
using color as the only status signal

single_file_compilation.style_source: inline the complete contents of tokens.css into a style element
single_file_compilation.script_source: inline the complete contents of interactions.js before the closing body tag
single_file_compilation.asset_policy: use inline SVG and CSS shapes only; do not introduce external URLs
